item.tib: dam can rgya mtsho'i dbyings nas thugs dam rgyud bskul
item.coloph: gyer spungs dran pa nam mkha'i lung don/ stang chen dmu tsha gyer med kyi snyan rgyud/ sprul sku blo ldan snying po'i dngos grub/ rjes 'jug las can skyes bu'i bkol byang*/ phyi rabs sgrub pa po yi spyod yul/ dam can srung ma rnams kyi 'phrin las rdzogs so//
